originality.statement: Original design for this repository: a round stage that shows a generated photograph of two rings and, only when the guest asks, swaps it for a procedurally generated 3D model drawn by a 6 KB dependency-free WebGL viewer, with scroll-linked reveals. No competitor page, asset, wording or layout was used as a reference.
